explanation: This is 0 at every D1 and GO step and is non-zero only at D2 when the agent chose a1 and reached S1 by the common transition, and only late in the episode (trial 84 or later; before that it is 0). On those late a1-to-S1-common D2 steps it is usually 8-10 when the previous trial was rewarded and the agent has been choosing a1 on recent trials, about 3-7 after an unrewarded previous trial or the first such trial after a switch, and 0 for every other case (a2, any rare transition, or reaching S2).
